scope: Drawing only; regular grid, miniature/mount and palette. No model, save, font, asset or animation changes.

candidate.identity: Definition ID/revision, orientation/line or named element, segment index; deterministic integer mixing, no time/frame/state seed
candidate.small_cells: Amplitude fades to zero at 4px and reaches full detail at 24px; no extra ticker
candidate.miniature: Unchanged proportional solid original RGB fills; X and unknown both neutral; stable frame shared by album and work

finite_cases.existing: 304 regular/corpus layouts, 80 V1 focused/recovery cases, six 1/11/17/40 status strips, current core/G1/GP48/H1/ZS2/save/500/pilot/spoiler suites
finite_cases.v2_grid: F01/F02 and VS04/VS08/VS09 at work/fit plus offered 12px, UI100/125; four surfaces and both modes through existing matrix
finite_cases.v2_projection: Mono and all four colors; equal fills with distinct X/unknown distributions; wrong fill/color; X-to-fill, fill-to-X/neutral, retraction, Escape/focus/opposite-button, commit, undo/redo, reset, album/sheet, fresh-process continuation
finite_cases.v2_stability: Geometry before/after redraw, progress/H1, sheet switch and fresh process; same environment and geometry only
finite_cases.windows: Fresh download for delivery head; both EXEs without arguments fresh/partial/solved, embedded PCK, normal/maximized clients, DPI separate from UI100/125, actual events, recovery and continuation

independent_oracles: Recompute stroke/AA envelopes from actual generated points and widths; every segment within reserved grid or mount bounds; no change to V1 fit/pitch/translation
Native four-edge coverage uses ink contribution rather than requiring two fully opaque pixels from a narrower antialiased stroke
Equal miniature pixel buffers for equal fills; positive original-color interior pixels and wrong fills required; input arrays and saved X remain exact
Actual grid ink differs from a straight-line reference within the declared corridor, remains stable under redraw and in a new process
Original minimum hit areas, cell centers and both sides of logical boundaries, independent clue navigation, group/recovery clearance

evidence.reference_use: Bound existing V1 PNGs only; no historical import in standard CI
evidence.bindings: Head/base/test-merge/run, plan/scripts/EXEs/embedded PCK/reports/images SHA256; assertions and saved image selection separate

amendments: If the finite candidate cannot satisfy the independent bounds, document a separate explicit amendment before new comparisons; preserve this original plan.
